Reload game Play online Playing a downloaded copy? Open the folder containing game in a terminal, then start a local web server: python3 -m http.server 8768 --bind 127.0.0.1 Leave that terminal open and visit 127.0.0.1:8768/game/. If that port is busy, choose a free port in both the command and address. Opening game/index.html directly as a file cannot start the game. Python is only needed for this local-server option. Read instructions Done reading Read without starting or resuming. Blue ground is safe from field enemies. Leaving it begins a vulnerable gold line. Return to blue ground to close the cut. Regions without a field enemy are revealed. In the revised Arcade chapters, closing a cut stops your craft: tap a fresh direction to fly again. Enemies on both sides can leave only your line captured. Use that line to begin another cut. A field enemy touching your unfinished line, or crossing your own line, costs a life. Border patrols can hit you on captured edges. Reach the coverage target and capture required objectives. Special challenge maps can limit the clock or live-line length; their briefing and HUD explain those limits. Keyboard: Tap a direction to fly. Tap another to turn. Up ↑ / W; down ↓ / S; left ← / A; right → / D; ability E; boost Left Shift / Right Shift; change craft G; pause Esc / P. Releasing a direction keeps you moving. Touch: drag the floating stick or swipe to turn. Choose a sliding D-pad, either hand, size and opacity in Settings. Releasing keeps you moving. Pause to take a break. Controller: Connect a controller and release its controls once. Both sticks work with the default layout. Up D-pad up, down D-pad down, left D-pad left, right D-pad right; Left stick. Stick / D-pad: steer · South: ability · West: supply · North: hangar · East: pause · Right shoulder: boost · Menu / start: pause. Lift the stick to keep flying. Stick / D-pad: navigate · South: confirm · East: back · Menu / start: resume. Shoulders / triggers: previous / next · West: confirm · North: back. Confirm a select or slider to edit; confirm again to apply or go back to cancel. Change your layout in Settings → Controller controls. Steam Deck: use a Gamepad layout for your browser in Steam Input. The system/Home button belongs to your device. Text entry and file pickers still use keyboard or touch. Some browsers also need a keyboard or touch action before sound can start. Menu navigation and silent gameplay remain available. Each class explains its actual effect in the flight deck. Scout shows current direction hints and hidden objectives; supplies refill charge-based classes. A shield absorbs one contact by safely cancelling the line. Campaign difficulty: Standard and Gentle reveal the same pictures and share mission and appearance unlocks. Scores and medals stay separate; equipment seals require Standard. A change during a flight applies to the next fresh attempt. Resume and Load preserve the current flight; Retry starts the selected difficulty from the beginning. Long flights: Replay recording and recoverable saves stop after 30 minutes of play. A flight can continue, but a completion after two hours cannot be kept in the collection. Pause when taking a break, and export your library to keep a backup. Ready to fly → Learn by playing Cancel course entry × YOUR FLIGHT LOG Your collection. Completed pictures stay here.
